description: Named in Georgian; English and Russian on an OSM node surveyed in September 2025; stands on Beri Gabriel Salos Avenue at the State Military Scientific-Technical Center Delta; the successor to the Tbilisi Aviation Manufacturing plant which built the Su-25; no serial known; operator recorded as Georgia because the plant and its successor are Georgian state entities and Georgia operated the type; if the airframe proves to be a pre-1991 factory example the operator should be revisited
